description: This file defines controller functions for managing credentials, including create, delete, retrieve, and update operations, using Express.js request handlers.

methods.name: createCredential
methods.description: Handles creation of a new credential, validating request body and workspace ID, then calling the credentials service.

methods.name: deleteCredentials
methods.description: Handles deletion of credentials by ID, validating parameters and workspace ID.

methods.name: getAllCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials for the active workspace, optionally filtered by credential name.

methods.name: getCredentialById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific credential by ID within the active workspace.

methods.name: updateCredential
methods.description: Updates an existing credential by ID, validating request parameters and body.
